1. (Currently Amended) An assembly comprising a test tube with an affixed MTP, wherein the MTP is a light-activated microtransponder distinct from passive RFID chips.

2. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in the test tube and the MTP is a light-activated microtransponder.

3. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, oriented for reading downwards, and the MTP is a light-activated microtransponder.

4. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the test tube is a biorepository test tube and the MTP is a light-activated microtransponder.

5. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer and the MTP is a light-activated microtransponder.

6. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube and the MTP is a light-activated microtransponder.

(Currently Amended) A system for storing samples and comprising the assembly of claim 1, and one or more of the following: a rack for biorepository test tubes configured specifically for light-activated microtransponder reading; an automated robot for moving racks or biorepository test tubes equipped with light-activation reading capability; and an automated sampling device adapted to sample said racks or biorepository test tubes and configured to interact with light-activated microtransponders.

14. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 13 adapted for low temperature operation, such that the racks/test tubes are handled at -20°C or less while maintaining light-activation reading functionality of the MTP.

15. (Currently Amended) A method of forming a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising embedding a light-activated microtransponder in plastic by heating the MTP to above the melting point of the plastic and melting a portion of the plastic with the heated MTP.

16. (Currently Amended) A method of reading an embedded light-activated microtransponder in a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising: providing an embedded light-activated microtransponder; and reading the MTP using light activation.

17. (Original) The method of reading of claim 16, wherein the embedding material is frost coated.

18. (Original) The method of claim 16, wherein the reader comprises a vial receptacle and wherein vial receptacle and the embedded MTP are maintained at a temperature of -20°C or less.

19. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer and the MTP is a light-activated microtransponder.

20. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 19, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube.

21. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 19, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, oriented for reading downwards.

22. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube and the MTP is a light-activated microtransponder.

23. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, oriented for reading downwards, and the MTP is a light-activated microtransponder.
